content: Kasala kerkerhe or'ori dardari ma kan horu ma narehi nalewen eni

Kasala kerkerhe Lira ma na'ono or'ori dardari man ik dernedi me'eni, ono ik kauroin kokkoo nahenia Yesus onne kulu narehi nano hophopon a'am raram! Kasala kerkerhe Lir onne leke yono ik holi kili'ur kani ko'or Ai, maa ik akin namkene naili'il mamani.
Nonolu hophopon a'am raram loikaru Makromod Lalap Nin keneri hono'ok ma namlolo laa ik upud a'ad, de inhoi kan derne nakani keneri hono'ok onne an lernala hunukum lernohi nina sale.

Enimaa lere eniyeni Makromod Yesus mehe nala or'ori dardari ma kan horu ma narehi nalewen maika me'e, de lo'o ik kak peinohi or'ori dardari eniyeni ik lernala hunukum man werek narehi. Lere Yesus minle noho wawan, An wakuku Lirna Wawa'an eniyeni, la ri man meher derne Lir onne laa loikaruwedi maika me'e, de ik kauroin Lirna Wawa'an onne namlolo kokkoo.

Lere onne Makromod Lalap hi'i tanada man ri kan dodo'onnala makun, la Ai nodi Nin molollo hi'i ha man ma'aruru nodi kunukunohi nahenia Lirna onne namlolo. Enla Roh Kudus nala woroin ma na'ono ri ma akin naili'il enihe dohodoho lernohi Nina honorok aki, leke ik kauroin Lirn onne namlolo kokkoo.
Yesus namwali ri mormori leke Ai nauroin kokkoo paku maika
Ler man mai Makromod Lalap hi'i noho worworu, de lere eniyeni ik mahak wakunu panaeku ma na'ono noho onne. Ai ka nala molollo hophopon a'am raram komdere noho worworu onne, maa nala ri mormori.
Ik kauroin onne, ono horhorok aile lolo Horok Lape ma na'aheni,

content.text: “Ri mormori ramwali inhawa penia O kam hamlinue? Ri mormori ananne onne ri mormori mehe, de alhi'ihepe O raram nodie?
Enimaa Om hi'i ai lolo yawa Num hophopon a'am raram tarana, maa ka nalo'olala O maledi onno man kulu ai leke lernala honoor hanawe noro ul'uli sa'sa'a,
la Om hi'i ai nodi molollo ha wo'ira na'akeme.”

content: Ende ik kauroin Makromod Lalap Nin panaeku hi'i ai
nodi molollo ha wo'ira na'akeme lolo noho wawan eniyeni. Memen lere eniyeni ik kauroin nahenia ri mormori ka nodi molollo ha wo'ira na'akeme man aile lolo noho eniyeni,

maa ik do'on Yesus penia ma nodi molollo ha wo'ira na'akeme. Lere An min noho wawan hophopon a'am raram rarehiyedi Ai tarana, maa Makromod Lalap kikan Ai naikoro onno man kulu narehi, la An lernala honoor hanawe noro ul'uli sa'asa'a man ma'aruru mamani, ono Ai nala kemen maki herredi maika. Makromod Lalap nala Nin rere'e harharu maika penia nala Yesus lernala apinpinha la maki leke na'uwara iknika dohohale na'akeme.

Makromod Lalap hi'i ha wo'ira man aile mai noho wawan, la na'akeme lernohi Nin kenekrohu. Ai raram nodi napolu ri mormori namansa ramwali Ai ananhe la nala hi morimori man ma'aruru wake'e. Onne penia An huriyedi Yesus lernala apinpinha, wewerek pananaka la maki. Ainin kenekrohu onne wa'an wake'e ono lolo ha onne na'akeme An hi'i Yesus namwali iknik Man Panulu kokkoo, ono Ai nauroin namlolo kokkoo nala or'ori dardari maika.

Yesus hi'i Nin ri mememen moumou dewdewe ono Ai na'amouwedi ik kemen nano dohohale me'e. Ai na'amou na'adewedi ika, penia ik koro Ai Aman mahaku. Onne penia Ai ka nawawa na'aheni maika kamwali Ai walinhe.
Ik kauroin onne ono lolo Horok Lape raram Yesus konohi Makromod Lalap na'ahenia,

content.text: “Na'amoli Ya'u loikaru Makromod Lalap Oin Naran laa i wal'uhe. Ya ahinara Num ul'uli sasa'a lolo heri leken kalarna.”

content: Yesus na'aheni wali'ur,
Enla lolo lisir namehin Yesus na'aheni,

content.text: “Eni Maya'u! Yo oro anumhe man Makromod Lalap naledi Maya'u.”

content: Makromod Lalap ananhe ri mormori nadedem, de mori ka nalo'ol ne, maki. Ende Yesus mai namwali ri mormori molmolo maika haenhi, Ai kemen naise ik kemen, la rarna naise ik rarna. Ai naise maika ri mormori, leke lere An maki Ai na'amoluloinedi Hayakyak Makromon nin molollo, de makmaki ka nodi molollo maika me'e.
Nonolu ri na'akeme ramka'uk maki, maa Yesus huriyedi ika nano makmaki nin molollo, de ik ka kamka'uk maki me'e.
Ende ik kauroin mouropo nahenia Yesus kan mai leke paku hophopon a'am raram, maa mai leke paku maika ma namwali Abraham upun anan.

Enpenia Yesus namwali iknik Imam Man Kulu Narehi ma nauroin paku ik wawa'an, ono Makromod Lalap nala Ai namwali ri mormori naise maika. Yesus naramyaka maika rehi, la namkene hi'i ha ma namlolo mamani. An ilitolle Makromod Lalap Nin honowok, ono Ai nala kemen maki namwali honoi kanani pair ika nik dohohale nin hunukum.
Ai namkene paku maika lere ika lernala kenene panatal, ono An lernala kenene panatal noro apinpinha haenhi.

footnotes.text: Lolo lisir eniyeni tafsiran heruwali na'ahenia ‘ai’ wekel ri mormori, maa tafsiran namehin na'ahenia ‘ai’ onne wekel Yesus.
